beats.care: Moved to Pune for college or work? Check your name, then register or change your address before Oct 26.
beats.what: Booth-level officers will sit at all polling stations on Oct 17, 18, 24 and 25 to take new registrations and corrections.
beats.why: District election officer Jitendra Dudi says the aim is that no eligible voter is left out of the roll.

cards.body: They will help at polling stations during the four camp days.
cards.caption: Booth-level officers on duty

cards.q: You just moved from Nashik to a Pune flat. Which form updates your voter address?
cards.why: Form 8 covers change of residence and corrections; Form 6 is for brand-new voters.

cards.body: You can call the voter helpline at 1950, or visit the help desk at the district election office or your electoral registration officer's office.
cards.title: Can't make it?

cards.q: Is your name on the voter list?

hook: Is your name on the voter list, or *missing* without you knowing?

learn.t: Form 6 registers a new voter, while Form 8 fixes your address, details or replaces your voter ID card.

sources.name: Punekar News
sources.title: Four-Day Special Drive at All Pune Polling Stations to Update Pune Electoral rolls; Claims Open Till Oct 26

tldr: Every polling station in Pune district holds voter camps on Oct 17, 18, 24 and 25, and claims close Oct 26.
watch: Claims and objections on the draft electoral roll close on October 26.
